findings.title: Mutual independence in the reference artifact is bought ENTIRELY with FIELD breadth, not with construction cleverness
findings.evidence: 50 alphas, 50 distinct data fields, 8 operators of which rank+ts_mean cover 46/50; median formula 20 characters. The README's 'unique method' that found 'over 400' such alphas is, structurally, enumerate the field catalogue and wrap each field in rank().
findings.why_it_matters: Marginal independence (L1.18, L1.61) is this desk's scarcest axis and it has been attacked from the OPERATOR side for six sessions (OP-093..OP-101). The one published artifact whose explicit purpose is constructing a mutually-independent set says the currency is the DATA FIELD. Two alphas over the same field cannot be independent however different their operators; two rank()s over different fields are independent almost by construction.
findings.mt5_translation: The desk's independence bottleneck is a DATA-AXIS problem, not a search-operator problem. It validates the free-data mining seats over further operator expansion, and it is what made this session go and count the desk's own field intake -- which is BH-S8-F2.

findings.title: The published performance column is a mass point at the submission bar, not a distribution
findings.evidence: Sharpe min = median = 1.25 = the platform's stated submission threshold, max 1.29; 50/50 clear it and none clears it by much. Decay carries eleven singleton non-round values (13, 18, 52, 55, 65, 70, 78, 90, 95) across a 4-axis settings grid (Universe x Decay x Truncation x Neutralization), so each 'alpha' is the argmax over an unreported per-alpha settings search.
findings.why_it_matters: This is a live demonstration of exactly what this desk's trial-accounting law exists to catch, produced by a process the crowd treats as authoritative. RECORDED AS A FACT ABOUT THEIR PROCESS, NEVER AS A GATE FOR OURS (L1.6): the numbers are uninformative about edge and informative only about the filter.
